name: USB-C PD board with 4S battery management

mentions.name: USB-C PD board with 4S battery management
mentions.description: A comprehensive USB-C Power Delivery board with 4S battery management, available in 3A or 8A versions, designed as a drop-in solution for implementing proper USB-C PD input.
mentions.problem: Doing proper USB-C PD input is nontrivial, so the board serves as a drop-in solve.
mentions.source_excerpt: A comprehensive usb c pd board with 4s battery management. 3a or 8a depending on version. Trying to do proper pd in is nontrivial so this is a drop in solve.
